tables.title: O utput control bits for complementary tim_ocx and tim_ocxn channels with break
tables.text: Table 550, "O utput control bits for complementary tim_ocx and tim_ocxn channels with break", in section 57.7.9 (TIM15 capture/compare enable register (TIM15_CCER)) on page 2886. Columns: Control bits, Control bits, Control bits, Control bits, Control bits, (1)Output states, (1)Output states. 12 data row(s). Notes: 1. When both outputs of a channel are not used (control taken over by GPIO controller), the OISx, OISxN, CCxP and CCxNP bits must be kept cleared.
